build_jhmdb_dataset: build a JhmdbDataset instance for topdown pose estimation with COCO-style annotations
parse_jhmdb_data_info: parse raw JHMDB COCO annotation into bbox, keypoints, and visibility arrays
convert_jhmdb_bbox: convert JHMDB matlab 1-based bbox coordinates to 0-based numpy arrays
extract_jhmdb_keypoints: extract 15 keypoints from JHMDB annotations including neck, shoulders, hips, and limbs
register_jhmdb_dataset: register JhmdbDataset module in the mmpose DATASETS registry for config-based instantiation
